title: Claude Skill Inception
summary: A collection of Claude Code 'skills' (markdown/YAML skill definitions) that Claude Code can invoke automatically, including a synthetic-data skill that generates Python scripts to create and evaluate tabular synthetic data. That skill's embedded scripts import SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table and evaluate output quality with sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality, making SDV a callable capability the AI agent invokes on demand.
evidence: synthetic-data/skill.yaml:169-228: embeds Python script importing GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and evaluate_quality from sdv
